summary: sync-pricing.service broken on VPS: tsx and dotenv are devDependencies but deploy tarball is pruned with --omit=dev, so npx tsx scripts/sync-pricing.ts fails in releases/<sha> (compounded by guru user having no writable HOME for the npm cache). Fix: move tsx+dotenv to dependencies; consider npm_config_cache/CacheDirectory in the unit.

resolution.note: tsx+dotenv moved to dependencies so the pruned release tarball ships them; runner now execs release-local node_modules/.bin/tsx instead of npx (guru user has no writable HOME for the npm cache)
